title: palicourea ruiz-teranii
intro: Palicourea ruiz-teranii, commonly known as "Hierba del cielo" or "Sky Herb", is a plant species in the family Rubiaceae. It is traditionally used in Peruvian medicine for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Palicourea ruiz-teranii include treating wounds, reducing fever, and alleviating digestive issues. The bioactive constituents of the plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
